name: Easy "Cheeseburger & Fries" Casserole with Classic Fixings

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g lean ground beef
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add both soups to the skillet with the cooked beef, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Transfer to a large baking dish and arrange French fries in an even layer over top.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (298 g) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (298 g) can cheddar cheese soup
1 (907 g) bag crinkle cut French fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Place casserole in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until the fries are golden brown, about 1 hour. Remove from oven.

When the casserole has about 10 minutes left, wash, dry, and roughly chop tomatoes. Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Roughly chop pickles. Place all three toppings on a plate and set aside for serving.
To serve, divide casserole between plates, then sprinkle with shredded lettuce and toppings. Drizzle with ketchup and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (227 g) bag shredded lettuce
⅓ cup ketchup
